title: GET /status publishes an unstructured OpenAPI response
reasoning: The handler returns a fixed two-field response, but FastAPI only sees a bare dict return type and no response_model. The nearby AuthStatus class is not a Pydantic/FastAPI model and is not attached to the route, so generated OpenAPI clients cannot rely on the concrete setup_complete/registration_open schema even though the route has a stable contract.
recommendation: Define a Pydantic response model for the status payload and pass it as response_model on @router.get, or annotate the return type with a typed model FastAPI can serialize into OpenAPI.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the route itself has no contract assertion in the included evidence.
suggestedRegressionTest: Assert that /auth/status returns exactly setup_complete and registration_open, and that /openapi.json documents both fields as booleans for the route response.
minimumFixScope: app/api/auth.py route declaration and response model for get_auth_status.
